traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT are fully implemented and verified by tests.
Core @supports functionality and format/parse rules are implemented in the valid-annotation-format rule and helpers, with explicit support for @supports lines and mixed @story/@req/@supports usage. Deep validation that each requirement ID exists in its specified story file is implemented in valid-req-reference helpers, including multi-story scenarios and requirement ID scoping per story. Error messages include the storyPath for missing requirements.
Backward compatibility is preserved: all legacy @story and @req behaviors remain, and tests explicitly confirm that unannotated functions still fail while functions annotated only with @supports satisfy both require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation. Mixed usage of both styles in the same file/comment is supported and tested. Documentation and ADRs describe @supports as the canonical annotation and match the implemented behavior.
Given the direct traceability annotations in code and tests referencing this story, plus a passing Jest run covering all relevant suites, this story is fully implemented and passes.
